build-and-check.text: Build the pinned documentation package with Nix. Flake checks validate rendered links, anchors, speech data and required pages, not protocol behavior.

edit-and-serve.text: Use the Nix development shell for a strict MkDocs build or live local server. A separate CI build verifies that shell.

publication-and-accessibility.text: Pull requests have a live preview without comments. Main publishes through GitHub Pages. The site includes a theme toggle and section read-aloud controls using browser voices.
